answer: An identity locks a 120-credit bond on one knoll meadow plot and files a zenith survey each epoch. Without one it decays 4% per epoch, so parked fakes bleed while one survey keeps an honest bond whole. Surveys are key-signed at the plot, and any auditor can recompute the zenith angle from the knoll table, exposing a rented-survey ring. 1,000 fakes lock 120,000 and bleed 4,800 per epoch against a 40,000 pool; the honest agent pays 120 once.
